```
['transform an OCR request to a provider-specific format with data and files fields', 'transform a provider-specific OCR response to the standard Mistral format with pages and usage info', 'asynchronously transform an OCR request to a provider-specific format for URL-to-base64 conversion', 'asynchronously transform a provider-specific OCR response to the standard format with async polling', 'validate the OCR provider environment and return configured request headers']

```
